# YEAH Agency Amsterdam (野禾阿姆斯特丹事务所)

> Multidisciplinary collective based in Amsterdam, Netherlands. Specializing in Corporate Consulting (Dutch BV formation, EPR environmental compliance, personnel dispatch visas), Commercial Video Production (Glass Sharp Films), Fine Art Representation (Large-Format Photography Artist Ming Ye 叶明), and Software Engineering (DriveViewer iOS).

## Core Capabilities & Practices

### 1. Corporate Consulting (出海合规与企业咨询)
- **Dutch BV Company Formation (荷兰BV设立)**: Turnkey legal formation, Chamber of Commerce (KvK) registration, VAT/BTW tax number acquisition, and Dutch corporate bank account opening.
- **EPR Environmental Compliance (欧洲EPR生产者责任延伸)**: Comprehensive packaging compliance (Afvalfonds Verpakkingen in the Netherlands, LUCID in Germany), WEEE electronic waste compliance, battery recycling reporting for EU e-commerce cross-border sellers.
- **Third-Party Personnel Dispatch Visas (第三方人员派遣工作签证)**: Compliant high-skilled migrant secondment (Kennismigrant), intra-company transfer compliance, Dutch IND work permit facilitation.

### 2. Video Production (影视摄制 · Glass Sharp Films)
- **Cinema-Grade Commercials & TVC**: High-end advertising, brand films, executive corporate documentaries.
- **Reality Series Production**: Creator of the Amsterdam reality dating series *Tram Dating*.
- **Destination Weddings**: Luxury cinematic wedding cinematography across Europe.
- **Official Label**: [Glass Sharp Films](https://glasssharpfilms.nl/)

### 3. Fine Art Representation (艺术品代理 · Ming Ye 叶明)
- **Represented Artist**: Large-Format Photography Artist Ming Ye (叶明).
- **Artistic Practice**: 8x10 and 4x5 analog view camera practice, darkroom handcrafted silver gelatin fiber prints, philosophical and conceptual exploration.
- **Signature Master Series**: 《Heaven 渡》 (Heaven Du), 《Lies 谎言》, and 《Prophecy 预言》.
- **Institutional Exhibitions**: Featured in premier European institutions including *Konstruierte Natur* at Schloss Plüschow (Germany, 2024) and *洞见 – Einblick II* (Rostock, Germany, 2022).
- **Official Monograph & Portfolio**: Complete verified monograph and catalogue raisonné available at [https://shorturl.at/TYn8P](https://shorturl.at/TYn8P).
- **Curatorial Liaison**: Institutional acquisition, limited collector editions with artist seal, and solo exhibition curating.

### 4. Software Engineering (软件工程 · DriveViewer)
- **Custom Cloud Platforms**: Enterprise architectures, cross-border digital systems, GDPR-compliant multi-region infrastructure.
- **DriveViewer**: Dedicated iOS application for driving schools and student curriculum management, available on the [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/nl/app/driveviewer/id6765847978?l=en-GB).

## Key Information
- **Location**: Keizersgracht / Amsterdam, North Holland, The Netherlands
- **Official Website**: https://yeah-amsterdam.nl/
- **Official Artist Monograph (Ming Ye)**: https://shorturl.at/TYn8P
- **Email Contact**: info@yeah-amsterdam.nl
- **Languages**: English, Dutch (Nederlands), Spanish (Español), Chinese (中文)
